normal.text: looks like Steam is now under attack as well? #steam #down

GPU upgrade done but the game still stutters? Nine times out of ten it's shader compiles, VRAM overshoot or a background indexer - not the card. Worked through the checklist that actually fixed it for us: https://gamingirdb.bearblog.dev/stutter-after-gpu-upgrade #pcgaming #hardware

normal.name: Nudlan
normal.text: Want a TL:DR on this #WoW Forever bull? A lot of armchair specialists, drama farmers & vapid #game discussion channels on Youtube are talking about the "WoW Forever Gold Farm situation." TL;DR: Blizzard's now 22y old software is bugged. Enemies drop too much stuff. Players with 5.th grade maths skills work this out, kill lots of these enemies to get lots more stuff. Anyone advocating for "bans" or calling out "bad actors" - ultimately this is Blizzard's fault, not the players. #videogames

normal.name: The Boss Rush Network
normal.text: Gamers are quick to complain about prices, but are we paying attention to everything else? LeRon calls on the whole “nation of gamers” to keep a closer eye on the industry. If we’re ready to call out the cost of games and hardware, he says, we should be just as ready to call out shady practices. We should also look at how we treat these companies and their employees. #GamingIndustry #GamingCommunity #GamingTakes #VideoGames #BossRushPodcast

They were still for sale, but now they cost 15890 NOK (1495 €). 😱 I haven't really paid attention to the prices, but W.T.A.F. Oh, and GFX cards in the 8000€+ range. 😵 Thank you AI! #Tech #AI #GamingPC #Gaming
